title: ModelDocViewStyle DetailViewStyle group-2 resource-reference insertion fast slice
scope: Serialize a changed DetailViewStyle boundary-line linetype reference when its source group-2 group-340 field is absent.
Preserve style-group ordering, aligned ASCII raw lexemes/Binary placeholders, and handle-reference mapping.
Verify typed same-version ASCII and Binary readback without adding repository fixtures or a CTest registration.

implementation.behavior: The copied DetailViewStyle raw carrier inserts group 340 inside an existing group-2 style block when the typed boundary-line linetype handle differs from the class default and no source group represented it. The handle is rendered as checked hexadecimal text; zero and sentinel handles are refused. The raw-object writer applies its existing source-handle remapping to the inserted handle group.
implementation.generatedControl: The secondary DetailViewStyle omits the group-2 group-340 reference while retaining the style-group marker. The test confirms the imported typed value is zero, edits it to the existing VIEW_STYLE_LINE linetype, verifies the full expected ordered raw stream, and checks typed ASCII/Binary readback resolves to that linetype.

limitations: Only same-version DXF serialization of this absent optional resource-reference field is covered.
Other absent fields, changed repeated-field cardinality, and unsupported raw carrier shapes remain fail-closed.
No DWG-origin typed output, cross-version translation, native style rendering, or consumer support qualification follows.
